column1: # Text-level meanings for the common library (2026-10-31): the words a learner can tap in a grove text
# that grove's word list (server/lexicon/sv-en.tsv, first Wiktionary sense of each headword) shows
# empty ("empty") or with the wrong word ("homograph", e.g. får → "sheep", i → "the ninth letter").
# Written by Claude from each word's use in the texts, in G-02's new_words shape (form, lemma, en).
# texts: "*" = every grove text where the form occurs; else the text IDs it applies to (a form that means
# different things in different texts, e.g. kort "card" / "short", has one row per sense).
# READ BY THE BUILD (RQ-466): "*" rows → server/lexicon/corrections.tsv (node scripts/build-lexicon.mjs --corrections), before the word list;
# rows naming texts → each grove text's own meanings (node scripts/build-library.mjs). Rebuild both after a change.
